text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last, the first race of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho, is here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan expresses her gratitude to me for helping her make it this far, and then heads out to the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, in this race she's always dreamed of, her battle against the skilled Ines Fujin begins!
